questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select No improvement.

The minister __promise to looked into__ the matter of fuel emissions and air pollution.
questions.solution:
• **The correct answer is Option 1.**
 
• The given sentence should be in the past tense i.e. 'promise' must be replaced by 'promised'. The infinitive verb follows the structure 'TO + V1' so replace 'to looked' with 'to look'.
 
• Therefore, the correct sentence is 'The minister **promised to look **into the matter of fuel emissions and air pollution.'

The next number in the given series is obtained by adding a consecutive prime number to the previous number.

2 + **2 **= 4,

4 + **3 **= 7,

7 + **5 **= 12,

12 + **7 **= 19,

19 + **11 **= 30,

30** + 13 = 43**

Hence, “43” is the correct answer.

questions.question: If BARBER is coded as 116 and GLINT is coded as 73, then how will LIZARD be coded as?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f8301e0e8e4527b4068d88f39c023c422c2d7237bc5e44bc5fc369291cb6009.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Reverse letter-pair combination for BARBER: YZIYVI

Now, Y + Z + I + Y + V + I = 25 + 26 + 9 + 25 + 22 + 9 = 116

Thus, the code for BARBER is 116.

Reverse letter-pair combination for GLINT: TORMG

T + O + R + M + G = 20 + 15 + 18 + 13 + 7 = 73

Thus, the code for GLINT is 73.

Similarly,

Reverse letter-pair combination for LIZARD: ORAZIW

O + R + A + I + Z + W = 15 + 18 + 1 + 9 + 26 + 23 = 92

Hence, 92 is the code for LIZARD.

questions.question: What was the day of the week on 15 August 2013?

2000 years + 12 years + 2013 ( Jan + Feb + March + April + May + June + July + till 15 august)

There are 3 leap years and 9 non-leap years from 2001 to 2012. Therefore, no. of odd days in this period = 1

Also, 2013 is a non-leap year.

Thus, odd days in the given above years = [0 + 1 + (3 + 0 + 3 + 2 + 3 + 2 + 3 + 1)] mod 7

Total odd days = 18 and 18 ÷ 7 = 4 (remainder)

Days codes:

 
 

 Sunday

Hence, “Thursday” is the correct answer

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the

statements.

All hens are eggs.

All birds are eggs.

All eggs are lions.

I. All hens are lions.

II. Some lions are eggs.

III. All birds are lions.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow.

questions.solution:

Hence, “all the conclusions follow” is the correct answer.

During a practice session in a stadium an athlete runs along a circular track and her performance is observed by her coach standing at point on the circle and also by her physiotherapist standing at the centre of the circle. questions.solution:

questions.question: The average of 1088 real numbers is zero. At most how many of them can be negative?
questions.solution:
We know, Average of quantities = sum of all quantities/no. of quantities

The average of 1088 numbers is zero.

So, the summation of 1088 numbers = 1088 × 0 = 0

If the summation of 1087 numbers = - (1088th number) then only summation of 1088 number will be zero.

∴ Out of 1088 numbers, at most 1087 numbers may be greater than zero.

questions.question: With reference to a number greater than one, the difference between itself and its reciprocal is 25% of the sum of itself and its reciprocal. By how much percentage (correct one decimal place) is the fourth power of the number greater than its square?
questions.solution:
Let the number be x.

According to the question:

X – 1/x = 25/100 × (x + 1/x)

⇒ x² – 1 = ¼ (x² + 1)

⇒ 4x² – 4 = x² + 1

⇒ 3x² = 5

⇒ x² = 5/3

⇒ x⁴ = 25/9

∴ Required percentage = frac{{( {frac{{25}}{9} - (5)/(3)} )}}{{(5)/(3)}} times 100 = 66.7\%

questions.question: AB and CD are two chords of a circle which intersect at a point O inside the circle. It is given that, AB = 10 cm, CO = 1.5 cm and DO = 12.5 cm. What is the ratio between the larger and smaller among AO and BO?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e60e161fe18d2aa130770be4be539d2eb0308aa4ef20f412217f3c3e95e38a0b.png] 

Let two chords AB and CD intersect inside the circle at the point O:

Hence **intersecting chords theorem** is used which means that the products of the lengths of the line segments on each chord are equal

AO × OB = CO × DO

⇒ x(10 – x) = 1.5 × 12.5

⇒ 10x – x² = 18.75

⇒ x² – 10x + 18.75 = 0

⇒ 100x² – 1000x + 1875 = 0

⇒ 4x² – 40x + 75 = 0

⇒ 4x² – 30x – 10x + 75 = 0

⇒ 2x(2x – 15) – 5(2x – 15) = 0

⇒ (2x – 5)(2x – 15) = 0

⇒ x = 5/2 or x = 15/2

When x = 5/2,

(10 – x) = (10 – 5/2) = 15/2

When x = 15/2,

(10 – x) = (10 – 15/2) = 5/2

∴ The ratio of the larger and smaller among AO and BO = 15/2: 5/2 = 3: 1

questions.question: The two diagonals of a rhombus are respectively, 14 cm and 48 cm. The perimeter of the rhombus is equal to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38d57be7996457ee0dbbcd103961234b329975b999ba6f16ccc788e6507860e3.png] 

In a rhombus, the diagonals bisect each other at right angle

Let the diagonal AC = 14 cm and BD = 48 cm

⇒ AO = 14/2 = 7 cm and BO = 48/2 = 24 cm

In ΔAOB, AB² = AO² + BO²

⇒ AB² = 7² + 24²

⇒ AB² = 49 + 576

⇒ AB² = 625

⇒ AB = 25 cm

∴ Perimeter of the rhombus = 4 × side of rhombus = 4 × 25 = 100 cm

questions.question: The platform of a station 400 m long starts exactly where the last span of a bridge 1.2 km long ends. How long will a train 200 m long and travelling at the speed of 72 km/h take to cover the distance between the starting point of the span of the bride and the far end of the platform?
questions.solution:
The distance between the starting point of the span of the bridge and the far end of the platform = 1200 + 400 = 1600 m

When the train crosses the bridge and the platform, it covers the distance = length of the bridge and platform + length of the train

⇒ Distance covered by train = 1600 + 200 = 1800 m

Speed of the train = 72 km/hr = 72 × 5/18 = 20 m/s

Time = Distance / Speed

⇒ Time = 1800/20 = 90 seconds = 1.5 mins

• It interconnects users with computer resources in a geographic area or region larger than that covered by even a large local area network (LAN) but smaller than the area covered by a wide area network (WAN).
